title: Advertise cache capabilities, not one ambiguous buffered value
finding: Diagnostics already separate source-cache bytes, mpv demuxer-cache-state, Native buffered/seekable ranges and packet budgets. Native seek readiness checks actual coverage and RAP presence. A new universal readiness enum is not justified by the current API.
novelty: Merge into the existing cache investigation; cue-less index items do not own general cache semantics.
next_action: Retain existing distinct diagnostics. Reopen when a consumer needs a decoder-ready or cross-track readiness contract that these fields cannot express; include sparse-track and missing-audio output witnesses.
reopen_condition: If upstream mpv already provides the needed state, wire and qualify it rather than implement another cache. Never infer all tracks ready from video bytes alone.

proposal_contract.Proposed mechanism: Distinguish raw bytes available, demuxed packets available, decoder-ready closure, browser-buffered media and a verified seekable interval. Reuse mpv knowledge instead of duplicating it.
proposal_contract.Smallest useful experiment: Compare cache reports for a sparse subtitle track, missing audio, cue-less file and a source whose byte cache is full but recovery point is absent.
proposal_contract.Correctness gate: Every exposed readiness level has a demonstrable operation that succeeds; source replacement invalidates observations; sparse tracks do not deadlock unrelated playback.
proposal_contract.Measure only after correctness: Fewer unnecessary reopen/read operations and more truthful diagnostics; not an automatic steady-state CPU gain.

upstream_evidence: Imported 2026-09-21 source review, not fetched or revalidated in this run.
